name: XiuRouter
description: Managed AI model API service with protocol-specific endpoints for OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages, and Gemini GenerateContent. It includes scoped API keys, per-request usage and cost records, usage-based prepaid pricing, and integrations for 14 apps and coding agents. Selected models and service groups currently save over 90% versus published provider reference prices; actual savings depend on the selected model and service group.
